'''Adventures''': {{adv|Diamond}} (son) |trainer=yes |trainerclass={{pkmn|Coordinator}} |game=yes |generation={{gen|IV}}, {{gen|VIII}} |games={{game3|Diamond and Pearl|Diamond, Pearl|s}}, {{v2|Platinum}}, {{pkmn|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl|Brilliant Diamond, Shining Pearl}} |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=DP001 |epname=Following A Maiden's Voyage! |enva=[[Sarah Natochenny]] |java=[[Makoto Tsumura]] }} '''Johanna''' (Japanese: '''アヤコ''' ''Ayako'') is the [[mother]] of the [[player character]] in {{game2|Diamond|Pearl|Platinum}}. She is an accomplished [[Pokémon Coordinator]] from [[Twinleaf Town]]. In {{pkmn|animation}}, Johanna is the mother of {{an|Dawn}} and appears as a recurring character during {{aniseries|DP}}. In the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}, she is the mother of {{adv|Diamond}}. ==In the core series games== Unlike previous mothers of player characters, Johanna is less content to stay at home. After the player begins their {{pkmn|journey}}, she can be found at the [[Contest Hall]] in [[Hearthome City]] and occasionally enters [[Rank (Contest)|Master Rank]] {{pkmn|Super Contest}}s with her {{p|Kangaskhan}}, [[nickname]]d '''Jumpy''' (Japanese: '''ガルちゃん''' ''Garu-chan''). She is also shown to travel to the [[Resort Area]], where every so often she will visit the player's [[Villa]]. She can also be encountered in the lobby of the [[Battle Hall]], where she will be cheering in support of the player. She seems to be a friend of the [[Contest Judge]] [[Keira]]. ===Pokémon=== ===={{game2|Diamond|Pearl|Platinum}}==== {{Pokémon/Contest |gen=4 |ndex=0115 |pokemon=Kangaskhan |nickname=Jumpy |type1=Normal |gender=female |move1=Dizzy Punch|move1cat=Cool|move1app=0 |move2=Endure|move2cat=Tough|move2app=2 |move3=Reversal|move3cat=Cool|move3app=2 |move4=Outrage|move4cat=Cool|move4app=2}} ===={{g|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl}}==== {{Pokémon/Contest |gen=8 |ndex=0115 |pokemon=Kangaskhan |nickname=Jumpy |type1=Normal |gender=female |move1=Fake Out|move1type=Normal|move1app=1 |move2=Endure|move2type=Normal|move2app=3 |move3=Reversal|move3type=Fighting|move3app=0 |move4=Bulldoze|move4type=Ground|move4app=2 }} ===Items given=== {{itlisth|normal}} {{Itemlist|Running Shoes|Given to the player before leaving on the journey|D=yes|P=yes|Pt=yes|BD=yes|SP=yes}} {{Itemlist|Guidebook|Given to the player before leaving on the journey|D=yes|P=yes|Pt=yes|BD=yes|SP=yes}} {{Itemlist|None|Given to the player in the [[Contest Hall|Super Contest Hall]]|D=yes|P=yes|Pt=yes|BD=yes|SP=yes|display={{tt|Tuxedo|If the player is a boy}}/{{tt|Dress|If the player is a girl}}|sprite={{#ifexpr: ({{#time: H}} mod 2)=0|Lucas|Dawn}} Contest BDSP OD|size=40}} {{itlistfoot|normal}} ==Gallery== ===Sprites and models=== {| style="margin:auto; {{color2|000|Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Johanna/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===History=== [[File:Johanna Younger.png|thumb|left|220px|Johanna when she was younger]] ====Pre-series==== As a young girl, she was shown participating in a Pokémon Contest in a flashback in ''[[DP095|Battling the Generation Gap!]]'' against her childhood rival, [[Lila]]. It was revealed that Lila was the first person to defeat Johanna, breaking her winning streak. However, after seeing how passionate Johanna was about Contests, she started questioning what she wanted to do. She sat down to talk to Johanna and the two decided they would pursue what they would be best at, with Johanna competing in Contests and Lila studying to become a [[Pokémon Stylist]]. ====''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''==== Johanna debuted in ''[[DP001|Following A Maiden's Voyage!]]''. She told Dawn that to become a great [[Pokémon Coordinator]], she would have to learn from {{pkmn|Trainer}}s and {{tc|Pokémon Breeder|Breeders}} as well. Later, when Dawn was about to leave for her {{pkmn|journey}} with a large suitcase full of clothes and jewelry, Johanna gave her a small [[Bag|backpack]]. In ''[[DP070|The Bells are Singing!]]'', it was revealed that she sewed {{TP|Dawn|Buneary}}'s vest. In ''[[DP125|Battling a Cute Drama!]]'', Dawn, {{Ash}}, and {{an|Brock}} received cold-weather outfits for the area surrounding [[Snowpoint City]] from her. [[File:Johanna gown DP141.png|thumb|250px|Johanna in the Twinleaf Festival]] Johanna appeared in ''[[DP138|Strategy Begins at Home!]]'' and met Ash and Brock in person for the first time. Together with [[Izzy and Cara]], she was planning the events of the [[Twinleaf Festival]]. She later had a [[Double Battle|two-on-two]] [[Contest Battle]] with her daughter, using her {{TP|Johanna|Glameow}} and {{p|Umbreon}} against [[Dawn's Piplup]] and {{TP|Dawn|Pachirisu}}. Although she won the battle with relative ease, she was impressed by Dawn's teamwork and complimented her. In ''[[DP141|Challenging a Towering Figure!]]'', Johanna was the hostess for the [[Festival Battle Challenge]] which was a part of the Twinleaf Festival. She wore a gown during the occasion. In ''[[DP167|Teaching the Student Teacher!]]'', Johanna was supposed to have a seminar for children, "My Very First Pokémon Coordinator Class," but she had to fill in for a [[Nurse Joy]] who was taking care of too many Pokémon as a judge in the [[Neighborly Town]] {{pkmn|Contest}}. Dawn volunteered to teach in her place. At the end of the episode, Johanna gave Dawn a new outfit to wear at the Grand Festival. Johanna made brief cameo appearances from ''[[DP174|Last Call — First Round!]]'' to ''[[DP176|Coming Full-Festival Circle!]]'', in which she watched Dawn compete in the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]]. She then appeared again in person in ''[[DP177|A Grand Fight for Winning!]]'', where she joined the audience. She also made a cameo appearance in the ending credits of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''. When Dawn returned home in [[DPS01]], Johanna decided to have her Glameow and Umbreon battle Dawn's {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}} and {{TP|Dawn|Cyndaquil}}. However, after Piplup and Cyndaquil started squabbling, the battle was stopped. She is last seen saying her farewells to {{an|Dawn}} on her journey to [[Hoenn]]. [[File:Johanna anime.png|thumb|250px|Johanna in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'']] ====''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''==== Johanna appeared in ''[[JN074|Nightfall? Nightmares!]]'', where [[Chloe]] watched a video of her being interviewed. During the interview, Johanna took the opportunity to promote a Contest that was to be held in [[Eterna City]]. ===Character=== [[File:Johanna and Dawn.png|left|thumb|250px|Johanna and Dawn]] Johanna is an accomplished [[Pokémon Coordinator]], having won the [[Ribbon Cup]] and the title of [[Top Coordinator]] after winning the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]] when she was younger. Dawn grew up inspired by her achievements and decided to follow in her footsteps, wanting to become a great Coordinator as well. When Dawn left on her {{pkmn|journey}}, Johanna gave her the first {{pkmn|Contest}} [[Ribbon]] she received, which both of them carried as a good luck charm. Johanna watches all of Dawn's Contests on [[television]] along with her {{TP|Johanna|Glameow}}. She also has newspaper articles about Dawn's victories and pictures of her competing in Contests and the [[Hearthome Collection]] in her living room. Although she keeps track of Dawn's journey, she doesn't like to get too involved, telling Dawn she would be better off relying on her friends and her {{cat|Dawn's Pokémon|Pokémon}} instead of her mother, and to use her losses as a learning opportunity. While one might think that her skills have gotten rusty since she became a [[mother]], it turns out that she teaches a {{pkmn|Coordinator}} class out of her home, even having a battlefield behind her house for instructing her students. As a result, her skills are still as sharp as ever, as shown when she battled Dawn. ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} This listing is of Johanna's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Johanna |pkmn=Glameow |type1=Normal |img=Johanna Glameow.png |epnum=DP001 |epname=Following A Maiden's Voyage! |vajp=Chinami Nishimura |vaen=Chinami Nishimura |desc=Johanna's {{p|Glameow}} was her main Pokémon as a Coordinator. At some point in her career, she recorded a dance video. ====={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}===== Johanna made a short cameo at the end of this chapter. ====={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}===== Johanna was first seen in ''[[PS351|Perturbed by Pachirisu]]'' when {{adv|Platinum}} was watching Johanna's dance video to practice for the [[Dance Competition]] of her first [[Pokémon Super Contest]]. She reappeared as a figment of {{adv|Diamond}}'s thoughts after the boy reminisced about the bonds that families share in ''[[PS382|Vexing Vespiquen & Unmanageable Mothim II]]''. She physically debuted in ''[[PS395|Stopping Sableye]]'' when Diamond learned that she had headed to [[Lake Verity]] to gather {{Berries}} and would be in danger because of [[Team Galactic]]'s plan to blow up the lake. He went there and found her being held hostage by the {{tc|Commander}} [[Mars]]. Johanna barely managed to escape with Diamond's help as he distracted Mars and allowed his mother to run away. After returning home alongside {{adv|Sebastian}} and [[Roseanne]], she realized that the jacket and shoes that she ordered for Diamond were gone, and conjured the idea to call him on the phone she left in a pocket. Soon, though, after he received her call, she heard from him that he was infiltrating their flying shuttle and would be having a showdown with Team Galactic, much to her shock. Sebastian traveled to [[Pastoria City]] with Johanna and Roseanne to inform {{adv|Pearl}} about Diamond's disappearance. ====={{MangaArc|Platinum}}===== Johanna became a Super Contest Coordinator once more by the end of this chapter. ====Pokémon==== {{anchor|Glameow 2}}{{TrainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Johanna |pkmn=Glameow |type1=Normal |img=Johanna Glameow Adventures.png |epnum=PS351 |epname=Perturbed by Pachirisu |desc={{p|Glameow}} is the family's house pet. It is also assumed to be her Contest Pokémon as it was shown that she earned many Ribbons in Sinnoh.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Johanna |pkmn=Kangaskhan |gender=female |type1=Normal |img=Johanna Kangaskhan Adventures.png |epnum=PS395 |epname=Stopping Sableye |desc={{p|Kangaskhan}} is Johanna's second seen Pokémon. She is assumed to be another one of Johanna's Contest Pokémon as shown in a picture of her and [[Dexter]].
